output.scope_note: The paper is a first-principles defect study of LiMnO2 and Li2MnO3 cathode materials. It reports formation energies, migration barriers and activation energies, but no ionic conductivity value in S/cm or similar units for a solid Li conductor; the only conductivity number (Massarotti et al., <10^-10 S/cm) is an electrical conductivity cited from another paper and is not an ionic conductivity.
